description: This file defines the routing component for a React web application, handling navigation, route matching, and redirection logic for different pages such as login, registration, error, and board views within the application.

methods.name: WorkspaceToTeamRedirect
methods.description: Handles redirection from workspace routes to team routes based on board data fetched via octoClient.

methods.name: GlobalErrorRedirect
methods.description: Redirects to error page if a global error is detected in the application state.

methods.name: FocalboardRouter
methods.description: Main routing component that sets up route paths and associated components, managing navigation and redirection logic.
